variant_intent.selected-strong: navy, the active category in a category row

a11y.fact: The control is a native <button type="button">, so keyboard activation, focus ring and disabled behaviour are the browser's own.

The selected state is exposed to assistive technology through aria-pressed (true for selected and selected-strong, false for unselected), and a caller-supplied aria-pressed overrides it because the passthrough props are spread after it.
The label is the button's text content, which gives it its accessible name.
